usedFor: CalendarHero holds meeting requests and Dropbox stores files, which “Upload File to Dropbox” saves from a public web link.

bestTemplate.name: “Meeting Request Becomes Event” in CalendarHero, then “Upload File to Dropbox” in Dropbox
bestTemplate.why: Once a request becomes an event, the action can save a prep file from a link into a chosen folder.

watchOut: “Upload File to Dropbox” lets you choose how existing files are handled, so set add, replace or update first.
